name: IBM DB2 for i
shortDescription: Provides secure read-only access to IBM DB2 for i (AS/400) databases through the JT400 JDBC driver with SQL security validation, rate limiting, and support for system naming conventions.

rawRecord.name: IBM DB2 for i
rawRecord.short_description: Provides secure read-only access to IBM DB2 for i (AS/400) databases through the JT400 JDBC driver with SQL security validation, rate limiting, and support for system naming conventions.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI assistants to query IBM DB2 for i databases and inspect database metadata including schemas, tables, views, indexes, and constraints. Features comprehensive SQL security validation to block dangerous operations, configurable rate limiting to protect database resources, and support for both environment variables and Docker secrets for credential management. Designed specifically for IBM i environments with support for system naming conventions and CCSID handling.
